task:
Change the cache-freshness policy in src/application/UpdateDocSets.ts for sources whose remote freshness CANNOT be determined, so the daily Composer pipeline stops re-scraping them blindly.

Current behaviour (verified): within the maxAge window the updater calls checkRemoteFreshness (checkGitFreshness for git sources, checkHttpFreshness for http). When the check CANNOT determine freshness - http: no ETag and no Last-Modified on the discovery URL, or the HEAD request errors; git: the stamp has no gitSha - it returns false ('assume stale, re-fetch to be safe') and the source is re-scraped in full. On the daily cron this makes heavy validator-less sources (cloudflare-blog ~7.8k pages, cloudflare llms-full ~54MB, vercel-blog/vercel-changelog, AWS services, postgres) re-fetch every single day; the 'warm' fetch is 62 minutes.

New policy: 'cannot determine' is NOT the same as 'changed'. When freshness cannot be determined AND prevStamp age is within maxAge, treat the cache as fresh and SKIP the fetch, logging one line per source: `[<name>] no remote validators; trusting cache (age Xh of Yh window)`. When age >= maxAge the source re-fetches as today - the window bounds the staleness. Sources with working validators keep today's exact semantics (verified fresh/changed daily).

Implementation guidance (alternatives allowed if the observable behaviour matches): checkRemoteFreshness currently returns boolean - make it (or an inner helper) tri-state: fresh / changed / unknown. 'changed' MUST still re-fetch (an ETag or SHA that differs is a real upstream change, never a skip). The tri-state must not leak into sources that CAN be checked - their path is unchanged. Do not touch src/application/sources.ts. Keep the change inside UpdateDocSets.ts unless a type genuinely belongs in src/domain/. No new dependencies. ESM imports keep their .js extensions.

Acceptance tests (you must write them): create tests/unit/application/update-doc-sets-trust-window.test.ts following the patterns in tests/unit/application/UpdateDocSets.test.ts (it exercises private methods via `as any` - do the same). Cover exactly: (1) validator-less http source, stamp age within maxAge -> SKIPPED (no fetch, the trust log line emitted); (2) same source, stamp age beyond maxAge -> fetched; (3) http source whose ETag CHANGED, within window -> fetched; (4) http source whose ETag is unchanged, within window -> skipped; (5) git source whose stamp has no gitSha, within window -> SKIPPED. Tests 1 and 5 must FAIL on the pre-change code (that is the sensor contract); 2-4 pin behaviour that must not regress.
rules: ESM-only repo: every import keeps its .js extension even though sources are .ts. Scripts run via node --import tsx/esm - no build step.
EDIT DISCIPLINE: no whole-file rewrites. Read the exact region first, then edit with exact oldText copied from that read. Run `pnpm lint` after every edit and fix what breaks before moving on.
Do not modify or weaken any existing test assertion. New tests go in tests/unit/application/update-doc-sets-trust-window.test.ts.
Do not run git commit / git reset / git checkout / git stash - the loop harness owns git state.
No new dependencies. Do not touch src/application/sources.ts.
A 'changed' freshness verdict (different ETag/Last-Modified/git SHA) must ALWAYS re-fetch - never turn a real upstream change into a skip.

sensors.name: judge
sensors.cmd: judge --base HEAD --spec 'The diff must change ONLY the cannot-determine-freshness path in UpdateDocSets.ts: when no validators exist (or the check errors / no gitSha) and the stamp is within maxAge, the source is now skipped with a one-line trust log; beyond maxAge it still re-fetches. Sources with working validators must behave exactly as before, and a changed ETag/Last-Modified/git SHA must ALWAYS re-fetch - turning a real change into a skip is a FAIL. The new tests must cover the five cases in the task and tests 1+5 must be incapable of passing on the pre-change code. Reject: tri-state leaking into the validatable path, new dependencies, sources.ts edits, paragraph-long justification comments, weakened existing assertions.' --model openrouter/moonshotai/kimi-k3
